lines: Jhuki jhuki si nazar, beqaraar hai ke nahin
couplets.en: Is there restlessness in that lowered gaze?

lines: Daba daba sa sahi, dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin
couplets.en: However well hidden, is there love in your heart?

lines: Tu apne dil ki jawaan dhadkanon ko gin ke bata
couplets.en: Count the beats of your young heart and tell me.

lines: Tu apne dil ki jawaan dhadkanon ko gin ke bata
couplets.en: Count the beats of your young heart and tell me.

lines: Meri tarah tera dil beqaraar hai ke nahin
couplets.en: Is your heart as restless as mine?

lines: Daba daba sa sahi, dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin
couplets.en: However well hidden, is there love in your heart?

lines: Teri ummeed pe thukra raha hoon duniya ko
couplets.en: In the hope of you, I am turning the world away.

lines: Teri ummeed pe thukra raha hoon duniya ko
couplets.en: In the hope of you, I am turning the world away.

lines: Tujhe bhi apne pe ye aitbaar hai ke nahin
couplets.en: Do you have that same faith in yourself?
